contract.exactAdmittedTypes: See finalSourceHashes model.bend source in sourcesBySha256: Use, Atom, Arg, CheckedArg, Field, Op, Block, Code are the exact native-admitted contract subset, not JS-expression strings.
contract.structure: Owned acyclic Block: Let(op,next), TestTag(atom,constructor,yes,no), Return(atom), BIRFail. Code bodies are owned trees in a list. Recursion follows direct Block children and list tails only. U32 code/local/constructor/field identities are labels; renderer never recursively dereferences a U32 graph. Code references permit runtime recursion without recursive compiler traversal.
contract.atoms: Local SSA-like ID, capture slot, U32 literal. Operands contain no effects. Source lexical indexes/names and dependent types do not enter renderer.
ops: Closure(codeId, ordered captures with affine/many use)
Direct(resolved symbolId, ordered live args with affine/many use): exact ABI entry only
Apply(closureAtom, live argument): one live runtime arrow
Construct(resolved constructorId, fields carrying field identity, slot, use, atom)
Project(atom, constructorId, fieldId, slot) after matching guard

callRules.erased: Checked frontend supplies per-application-occurrence source-slot quantities after dependent instantiation. Erased has no runtime Atom; lower_args consumes it without generating evaluation or Apply. Erased runtime binders/captures/fields disappear. Never erase solely because domain is Type.
callRules.affineMany: Both are live. Metadata is retained in Arg/Field/capture uses; JS GC ABI renders both equally. Ownership-aware targets must obey the proven usage and representation policy rather than re-infer dependent types. This model does not re-prove quantity correctness of its IR.
callRules.exact: Direct is legal only with certified complete entry arity and ordered live arguments. Arity means selected runtime entry, not number of source applications. No argument syntax inspection.
callRules.partial: Lowering emits Closure to a lifted adapter with explicit already-evaluated live captures; the adapter takes remaining live arguments in source order. c1 is the fixture adapter. No generic PAP table or telescope reconstruction in renderer.
callRules.over: Lowering splits saturated entry call from applications of the returned value. Every later effectful operand is materialized after the appropriate prior application; c2 event9 precedes extra argument event3. Do not flatten an arbitrary application spine into one eager argument array.
callRules.unknownCallee: Use Apply one certified live arrow at a time. A returned closure carries code/env ABI, not source type syntax. All-erased prefixes consume metadata only; returning erased binders must follow checked erasure semantics.

contract.closureRules: Checked lexical binding identities determine free variables. Runtime lowering emits deterministic live capture order, capture uses and code parameter IDs. Code body accesses Capture(slot), never EmitEnv type closures. Model c1 captures x=20 and subtracts its later y.
contract.constructorRules: Frontend supplies resolved constructor/family/field identity and instantiated erased/live field decisions; target ABI assigns tag, packed slot or native scalar projection operation. The model records IDs70/71, fields100..113 and numeric slots. Production must map declared names to existing JS ABI property keys/native intrinsics; model numeric-key layout is NOT a proposed silent ABI change.
contract.matchRules: Evaluate each scrutinee once in source order; compile checked patterns to ordered TestTag branches and explicit guarded projections. Bindings are fresh local IDs, erased fields have no runtime binding. Nested/multi-scrutinee cases become nested tests; retain source clause order and fail-stop. Native scalar/string/array tests/projectors are explicit target primitive operations, not source-pattern inference.
contract.productionPrimitiveExtension: Production adds a closed PrimitiveId plus ordered atoms, runtime representation and effect/calling-convention metadata for existing native operations, scalar tests and conversions. Live type/quantity values lower to structured descriptor constructors and explicit descriptor primitive operations where semantics require them; preserve existing runtime descriptor behavior, not compiler js_type/js_reduce. These extensions are specified requirements, not claimed implemented/tested by this subset.

Existing JS GC versus native affine ownership/copy/drop policy, numeric width/wrap and foreign effects. These are ABI choices, not dependent typing.
